messages:
Mel: T-minus 35 until the change window closes. Requesting a safety lift for the analytics hotfix — need pin approval for v2026.03.17-hotfix. Quick yes/no.
Raj: Do we have a canary health snapshot? any errors in the last 10m?
Sasha: Canary at 20% traffic. health checks passing but saw a CPU blip on embed-service around 18:12. autoscale kicked once.
Tomas: Noted p99 jumped to ~450ms in eu-west-1 for a 3-min window, coincident with the blip.
Elaine: Looks like KV cache miss rate spiked on a subset of hosts. Warmup lag. I recommend we avoid full rollout until we confirm cache stabilization.
Raj: If we hold, what's the rollback threshold? proposing: error rate >3% OR p99 > 300ms for 3 continuous minutes -> automatic rollback. Agree?
Mel: Agree on rollback criteria. Also consider reducing embeddings batch size to 8 to lower tail latency. Sasha, can you try a quick config tweak on canary?
Sasha: Applying change to canary now: 
```
# adjust batch size for embed worker
/deploy edit-config service=embed-service batch_size=8 --target=canary
```
Sasha: deploy-bot triggered the change.
deploy-bot: config-update: service=embed-service version=v2026.03.17-hotfix config=embed.batch_size=8 target=canary status=applied
Sasha: Patch is in, watching metrics.
deploy-bot: canary-report: traffic=20% success=98.6% warnings=1 (cache-warmup transient). p50=35ms p95=120ms p99=210ms errors=0.8% links: https://metrics/redwood/canary/2736459870
Tomas: p99 dropped back to ~210ms after the config change. Still slightly above baseline but much improved.
Elaine: Cache miss rate trending down. I think it's safe to proceed to pin+rollout with the rollback guard.
Mel: Requesting formal pin: /release pin v2026.03.17-hotfix -> please ack the pin so deploybot can proceed.
Raj: Ack pin.
Sasha: Ack and starting staged rollout sequence.
Tomas: I'll watch eu-west and us-west error budget. If the rollback guard trips, I'll initiate the rollback lane.
deploy-bot: pin-confirmed: v2026.03.17-hotfix pinned by Raj. Starting staged rollout: 20% -> 50% -> 100% (5m soak between ramps). Canary artifacts archived: s3://releases/2026/03/17/hotfix/canary.tar.gz
Mel: :thumbsup: Good. Add note to release notes: short description + emergency rollback criteria.
Raj: Added to release notes: "analytics: fix skew on aggregated metrics; reduced embed batch size to stabilize latency. Rollback criteria: >3% errors or p99 >300ms for 3m."
Sasha: Rolling to 50% now.
deploy-bot: rollout-update: traffic=50% status=in-progress next=100% after soak window 300s
Tomas: Monitoring - eu-west p99 stable ~220ms, errors flat. No signs of recurrence.
Elaine: KV miss rate back to baseline in the last 2m.
Mel: Proceed to 100% when traffic is stable for the remainder of soak.
Sasha: Moving to 100%.
deploy-bot: rollout-complete: traffic=100% status=success time=12m total_downtime=0s
Mel: Pin lifted from release board: will keep the version pinned for 2 hours for observation then unpin if stable.
Raj: I'll keep an eye for 30m and escalate if anything pops.
Tomas: If anything odd, use rollback command: 
```
/deploy rollback v2026.03.17-hotfix --reason="auto-rollback-trigger or manual"
```
Mel: Thanks everyone. Closing thread once the 2h watch is up. :coffee:
